# jev-receipts

JEV booking layer — receipts for the duke-lab instrument. Hash-chained, deterministic, cross-language contract.

## Fleet canary (pinned)

```javascript
const { fnv1a } = require('jev-receipts');
const got = fnv1a('café Δ 日本語');
console.log(got === 0x024a555471370b18n);  // true
```

This is the **fleet's cross-language crack-detector**. The same input must produce the same output across TypeScript (twist-engine), Rust (jev-quilt), and WASM (duke-lab).

## Usage

```javascript
const { ReceiptChain, JevCell, bookArgument } = require('jev-receipts');

const chain = new ReceiptChain();
chain.book('run.start', '{when: 0}');

// Each entry testifies about the one before it (FNV-1a chained).
console.log(chain.verify());  // true
```

## Source

This package is the npm distribution of [duke-lab/jev-receipts.js](https://github.com/SuperInstance/duke-lab). Cross-language contract pinned in JEV-SPEC §6.
